subject: Post-demo: procurement ops checklist — marketplace vs PO, SOC2/DPA gating
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Vargas <lina@procureops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: procurement ops checklist — marketplace vs PO, SOC2/DPA gating

Hi Lina — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams can evaluate paths that work for ProcureOps.

Recap from demo:
- Primary use: inference at scale for customer support automation (expected 5M tokens/month initially).
- Target go-live: late Q1/2027.
- Key constraints: vendor security evidence (SOC 2 Type II), DPA, and finance prefers PO for contract > $50k annual; procurement is open to marketplace if legal approves standard terms.

Suggested next steps (pick what makes sense):
1) I'll share a short procurement checklist (attached) summarizing PO vs marketplace trade-offs and paperwork required.
2) If procurement wants to go PO route, Ben can scope how to produce a simplified SOW + quote for your finance team.
3) If security needs to run a questionnaire, please send the current spreadsheet — we can pre-fill where possible and flag known gaps.
4) If you'd like, we can open a short path for a marketplace pilot to get you running on a card while legal completes PO paperwork.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf (SOC 2 highlights), Redwood_DPA-Overview.docx (redlines we accept), Procurement-Checklist-Redwood.txt (procurement ops checklist summary).

Would you prefer me to loop in your procurement lead now or wait until security confirms the questionnaire scope?

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0130

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement ops checklist — marketplace vs PO, SOC2/DPA gating

Sean — really helpful, thank you. A few clarifying points from procurement/security side: 

1) Procurement would prefer to understand lead time for a PO flow (how long to review/approve; do you require a master subscription agreement?).
2) Security will run the questionnaire — attaching our standard questionnaire. Can your security contact pre-fill the vendor sections?
3) Marketplace: finance wants to know if marketplace billing can be consolidated across several teams (we run multiple projects).

I've attached our questionnaire (ProcureOps_Security-Questionnaire.xlsx). Please have your security/compliance owner fill what they can and call out any blockers. If you can also confirm whether Redwood's DPA accepts amendments from enterprise customers, that'll speed things up.

Can you loop in Ben for the PO/quote sizing and Marissa for contractual SLAs?

Thanks — Lina
Head of IT & Procurement | ProcureOps
(attachment stub: ProcureOps_Security-Questionnaire.xlsx — 220KB, XLSX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ProcureOps questionnaire + procurement questions

Forwarding Lina's note for visibility. Ben — can you confirm the typical timeline for PO acceptance and what we need from legal to push a master subscription agreement? Also — marketplace billing across teams is possible but requires consolidated billing SKU; finance needs to know whether ProcureOps will accept a single consolidated invoice or separate projects.

Quick answers I can provide now: 
- DPA: we accept customer-suggested amendments for enterprise deals; we route through legal and try to limit commercial changes.
- SOC2: the attached summary covers scope and last audit date (June 2026). If they need the full report we can coordinate an NDA and SOC2 bridge call.

Ben — please produce a short PO quote (line items + expected monthly token tiers) and a 1-page SOW draft for a PO path. If marketplace preferred, note monthly commitment required for consolidated billing.

Marissa
Sr. Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ProcureOps questionnaire + procurement questions

Thanks Marissa — copying in the proposed quote template below for quick review before I formalize.

Proposed PO quote (summary):
- SKU: RED-INF-S-1 (consolidated monthly plan) — $8,500/month (up to 5M tokens)
- Overages: $0.0018 per token thereafter
- Term: 12 months (auto renew) — option to upgrade to dedicated reserved capacity at 9+ months
- Billing: monthly invoice payable NET30 to Redwood Inference, PO required for first payment if annual consolidation > $50k

Timeline notes:
- Produce quote + 1-pg SOW: 1 business day after final usage numbers from ProcureOps
- Legal review (DPA/any commercial amendments): typically 5–10 business days for standard enterprise amendments; longer if multiple redlines.

Ask: Sean — can you confirm whether ProcureOps prefers consolidated invoice (one PO) or separate POs per project? Lina's note suggests they want consolidated but I'll confirm with procurement email.

Ben
Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
